desc.en: A dragon that has survived the Dusk era for a particularly long time. It mostly only leaves its nest to feed, and one should prepare themselves for the worst if targeted as its prey.
desc.ja: 竜の中でも黄昏の時代を生き残り成長していった竜。基本的に食事以外では巣からでることはないが、獲物と認識されてしまった場合は覚悟を決めなければいけない

note: Get Silver Dragon to transform to this on turn 4
